title: Written incident report at Colonel Spraker's office, never given a copy
place_text: Ellsworth Air Force Base, South Dakota

tellings.quote: handed me these he handed me these forms he said I need you to write down every single thing that happened on that site tonight from the time you got this alarm to to the completion

plain: A former guard at nuclear missile sites, Mario Woods, says that in 1977 at Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota, after a night when he answered an alarm and says he was abducted, he was called to the office of a Colonel Spraker. He says the colonel handed him forms and told him to write down everything that happened on the site, from the alarm to the end, and that he was never given a copy. He tells it as a sign that an official record of his night exists somewhere.
